author: claude-opus-5-5
reviewer_feedback: Taller outer body with a softly pointed top and smooth sides; narrower lower body before the side panels; symmetric outward-flaring panels with curved upper edges; a wider inner shape with slanted upper sides, curved lower sides and a downward tip; clear inner/outer spacing
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark against the reference and the rejected drawing. The hood is one smooth symmetric stroke: convex sides to a soft point, a narrowed leg, and flaring cape panels with curved upper edges; the face opening is a closed diamond with slanted upper and curved lower sides, 9+ from the hood.
omissions: The panels are open flares (no inner edge) to keep 8 from the face; the face opening is 12 wide, limited by the 8-unit clearance to the hood.
lucide_reference: No Lucide hood; soft-pointed arch as in 'shield'.
